rules.title: AA contrast and visible focus
rules.statement: Text/control contrast ≥ 4.5. :focus-visible on interactive chrome. Selected nav text is foreground-on-surface, not accent-on-tint.

rules.title: Tap targets and type ramp
rules.statement: Phone: tap targets ≥ 44px, type ramp 12–40 (display up to 46 on luxe), spacing token 8px, tabular figures on numbers. Desk keeps desktop IA — premium is not an iPhone tabbar.
mustNot: boxed 1080 phone shell on a gestionale

rules.title: Empty / loading / success / error
rules.statement: Every compose ships visible empty, loading, success, and error states. Motion only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
mustNot: Nessun elemento as the only empty copy

rules.title: Original marks, no clone set
rules.statement: Sector pictograms are original. Filled navy chips for utility/editorial/ops. No placeholder geometry, no hotlinked Unsplash/Apple/Emergent bitmaps.
